V12/ShimmerText.title: Shimmer text
V12/ShimmerText.summary:
A label that shows live work: a band sweeps through words that rest a step
quieter and show one weight step heavier under the band. It runs on the skeleton
wave's angle.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
| Pattern        | Where                      | Values                                                                                                                    |
| -------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Pass           | While `active`             | The band crosses from wholly before the words to wholly past them, standard-productive, then rests 500ms and passes again |
| Speed          | By the words' length       | 0.09px/ms at 66px of words, 0.16px/ms at 381px, linearly between, held outside                                            |
| Band           | Each pass                  | Soft, 75% of the words' width along the sweep, between 96 and 240px; one weight step up, as a stroke                      |
| Colours        | Per theme                  | The rest 4.5:1 on its backdrop; the band 2.25:1 on the rest; solved as it starts and when a theme changes                 |
| Start          | Mount, or turning active   | The first pass sets off at once, from before the words                                                                    |
| Wave           | Labels that start together | One wave on the skeleton wave's 45° angle; a change of words keeps the phase                                              |
| Active off     | `active` false             | The band goes at once; the words' colour moves to the host's over fast-02, standard-productive, and back                  |
| Reveal         | `playShimmerReveal`        | Words arrive under one crossing at the label's own speed, without the rest; the first pass follows one rest after         |
| Off screen     | A hidden label             | The pass holds and comes back on its phase                                                                                |
| Reduced motion | Every change               | Plain text in its host's colour; the reveal shows the words at once                                                       |

V12/SideNav.title: Side nav
V12/SideNav.summary:
The app's page navigation, on the selection family's look and motion. It is a
`<nav>` of real links, not a tablist: each `SideNavLink` is an `<a href>`, or a
router link through `as`, and the current page is `aria-current="page"`.
`SideNavGroup` is a collapsible group of links under a header. A group opens
when you go to one of its pages and never shuts on its own. With `collapsed`,
`defaultCollapsed` or `collapsible`, and an icon on every top-level row, the nav
folds to a rail of icons. In an AppShell the shell draws the fold toggle;
elsewhere it sits at the nav's foot. `filter` pins a field at the top that
narrows the nav to the matching links; in a ghost nav the field is ghost too,
and hovers as a row does. Every link and group header is a tab stop.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Glide:** within a group, the selector glides to the new page on the kit's
  timing by travel, its leading edge ahead. A press reaches toward the pressed
  link; slide to another link to retarget, or off to cancel. There is no drag.
- **Jump:** between groups, by default, the old selector shrinks 2px on every
  side, opaque, and is gone. Then the new one comes in at the new link from 2px
  in on every side, growing to full. The whole jump runs on fast-01: a third for
  the out, on exit-productive, and two thirds for the in, on entrance-snap. The
  hover on the new row shrinks with the old selector.
- **Landing:** a clicked row keeps its hover round the selector until the
  selector lands on it.
- **Pass:** with `crossGroup="glide"`, the selector glides between groups too.
  It is clear over each group header it passes, soft at the edges.
- **Group:** opening and shutting is the shared disclosure: the step for the
  travel, a shut one step faster. The links wait 8px above and come down over
  fast-02 once the body is half open. They hold still on the way out.
- **Group bar:** when the group holding the current page is shut, the selector
  leaves and a 2px bar marks the group's header. It comes in from half height,
  opaque, on entrance-productive over fast-02. It goes back to 70% on
  exit-productive over fast-01, fading as it ends.
- **Arrival:** when the selector has nowhere to come from, as on a row that an
  opening group reveals, it grows from 4px smaller, opaque, over fast-02 on
  entrance-snap.
- **Rail:** folding and unfolding is one motion. The width moves on
  standard-productive, its duration from the distance, a fold one step faster.
  The content holds still while the moving edge clips it under a soft edge.
  Unfolding, the labels slide in from the icon gap on a clock one step longer
  than the width's. Open groups fold on the same clock.
- **Overlay:** with `expandOnHover`, the rail expands over the page after the
  pointer rests on it for 250ms, and folds again when it leaves.
- **Ghost container:** with `frame="ghost"`, an open group is a container that
  grows out of its header's hover on the group's clock. Shutting, it shrinks
  back to the row, then fades over fast-01. With `shadow`, it casts the cast
  shadow, lit from the pointer. The shadow fades in as the container grows and
  out as it shrinks.
- **Still:** with `still`, or while there is a filter query, groups open and
  shut at once, and the selector arrives and leaves at once. A move to a new
  page still glides.
- **First paint:** no motion. The groups that hold the current page mount open.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
Within a group, the selector fades in at the new page while it fades out at the
old one, at half the duration. A jump puts the selector at the new page at once.
A group opens or shuts at once, and its links fade in on the reduced clock. The
bar and the ghost container change at once. The rail's width changes at once and
its labels only fade: out before a fold, in after an unfold.

V12/SidePanel.title: Side panel
V12/SidePanel.summary:
A panel at the side of the page, for a task beside it. It has a top bar with the
close button, a title block, an optional toolbar, a scrolling body and up to
three footer actions. It is controlled: every way of closing calls
`onRequestClose`, and only `open` closes it. `frame` sets what it stands on:
flush against the edge, inset 8px from the edges, or floating over the page.
With `includeOverlay` the page dims and focus stays in the panel. With `slideIn`
the page makes room instead of being covered.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Snap by its edge:** a flush or inset panel grows from the middle of the edge
  it is attached to. Its width starts at nothing and its height at 60%. Under
  4px wide it fades with its width, so no sliver shows.
- **Axial timing:** by its edge, the width takes the whole clock, set by the
  larger axis's travel. An md panel takes moderate-03, 300ms. The height is done
  at 0.55 of that, 165ms.
- **Snap, floating:** a floating panel grows from the press that opened it, or
  from its launcher's center when a key opened it, clamped into its box. Its
  height starts at 75% and its width at 25%. Over 320px it takes the larger
  surface's timing.
- **Content arrival:** from the first frame, the content moves 8px into place
  from where the panel grows: along x by its edge, along y floating. It runs on
  entrance-productive, one step or 60ms longer than the longest axis clock,
  whichever is sooner. A 300ms width gives 360ms.
- **Collapse exit:** leaving, the far edge pulls back to the near one, the other
  axis held and the content still. By its edge, that is the edge it is attached
  to. Floating, it pulls back toward the edge nearest its cause, to 70%, fading
  over its last 40ms or 80ms by its clock, and is gone on its last frame.
  `exit="reversed"` plays the entrance back instead.
- **Push:** with `slideIn`, the page's margin on that side moves on the panel's
  width clock and curve, in and out, so the gap holds. The room is the panel's
  width plus an inset panel's distance from the edge. A floating panel never
  pushes.
- **Overlay:** with `includeOverlay`, the dim fades in over moderate-01
  (entrance-productive) and out over fast-02 (exit-productive), from wherever it
  is.
- **Step swap:** a new `currentStep` swaps the body out, then in. Past the first
  step a back button shows.
- **Condensed title:** with `animateTitle`, the title scrolls with the body.
  Once it is under the top bar, the bar takes its fill and divider, and the
  small title fades in and rises 4px over fast-02.
- **Tooltip hold:** the tooltips of its icon buttons wait until the panel and
  its content have landed, then open against their final box.
- **Turning round:** reopened while it leaves, the content goes on from where it
  is.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
By its edge, the panel only fades, at its final geometry, on half the clock. A
floating panel is there or gone at once. The content has no lead. The page makes
room at once. The overlay fades on half the clock. A new step shows at once. The
condensed title fades without rising.

V12/Slider.title: Slider
V12/Slider.summary:
A value or a range on a line. `Slider` takes Carbon's API: one knob, or two with
`unstable_valueUpper`, the number fields beside it, `invalid` and `warn` with
one message line under it. It adds `shape` (line, track or knob), `steps` for a
few named stops, `snap` and `ticks`, `fillStyle`, `knobShape`, `status`,
`gradient`, `reference`, `ai` and `loading`. `SliderSkeleton` is the slider
while it loads, at its own size.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Glide:** a key or a click sends the knob from where it is to the new value,
  on standard-productive. Its duration comes from the distance. The leading edge
  runs a little ahead, then both land together. A held key's repeats move at
  once.
- **Press:** a press on the line starts the knob toward the pressed point. The
  release lands there.
- **Drag:** the knob follows the pointer exactly and squashes against the ends
  and the other knob. A drag begun from a press glides to the pointer first.
- **Snap:** with `snap`, the knob glides stop to stop as the pointer passes each
  halfway point. With `sticky`, the default, it holds until the pointer is a
  quarter stop past halfway, at most 8px, and leans up to 3px toward the pull.
- **Hover and press:** hover grows the knob 2px. A pointer press takes back 1px.
  A press with no hover, a key or a touch, insets it 1px. On fast-01.
- **Fill:** rides the knob's live center on every frame. With `fillStyle` both,
  hover steps it toward the knob's color and from 2px to 3px; a press keeps the
  hover's weight. `contrast` is the color only, `thickness` the weight only. On
  fast-02, standard-productive.
- **Stop dots:** on the track shape, the dot under the pointer grows, and a
  press on it glides the knob there. While dragging, the stop the knob left
  shows as a short pill.
- **Status:** a change of `status` wipes the new color in from the knob along
  the fill, with a soft edge, on a glide's clock for the fill's length. On a
  range the two wipes meet midway. A change mid-wipe stops the old one where it
  is and wipes in over it.
- **Message:** the old message fades out on fast-01, then the new one fades in
  where it is. An error fades in on moderate-02.
- **Meeting:** two pills swell into one shape as they near. Two circles fill
  their overlap. On one value they join as one pill with a line at the seam; the
  seam grows on moderate-01, entrance-productive, and goes on fast-01,
  exit-productive. Let go within 4px of each other, they snap together. Two
  triangles stop where their stems meet, and the shared stem grows 2px taller.
- **Readout:** with `steps` and `readout`, the step's label rolls as it changes,
  up and down or, with `readoutDirection="horizontal"`, across.
- **AI:** with `ai` on the track, dots cover the fill and the knob is their
  lens. A change sends a wave from the knob's new place. On the special step the
  dots come in from the knob, each on slow-01, entrance-productive; leaving,
  they go left to right, each on moderate-03, exit-productive, over a slow-01
  sweep. There the knob becomes a disc in the AI color, scaling in on
  moderate-02, entrance-expressive, and out on fast-02.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
No glide: the knob moves to the new value and fades in there, on half the clock.
A snap is the same fade. There is no press reach and no lean. A status lands at
once. The message changes at once. The readout swaps in place. The joined seam
and the triangles' stem change at once. The AI dots come and go at once and hold
still, and the AI disc scales on fast-01. The knob's hover and press keep their
clock.

V12/Snap.title: Snap
V12/Snap.summary:
The timing for floating surfaces by their size: a large surface takes the
surface rule's duration by travel, a small one keeps the floating rule.

V12/SplitButton.title: SplitButton
V12/SplitButton.summary:
A primary action, and beside it a chevron that opens a menu of related actions,
with Carbon's ComboButton props. Not for two equal actions: use two Buttons. One
shell in two cells, on the Button's look: `kind` primary or secondary, `variant`
filled, outlined or tonal, sizes xs to lg. `busy` shows a spinner in the
action's place while it runs.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Hover:** the Button's glow in each cell, clipped to the cell, with no
  growth.
- **Press and release:** the Button's pressed color and release circle, clipped
  to the cell, with no press-in.
- **Chevron:** it turns while the menu shows.
- **Menu:** the Menu's open and close, from the press point or, with
  `openFrom="trigger"`, the chevron's center. The menu is at least as wide as
  the shell.
- **Busy:** out, then in. The label fades out, then the spinner draws on; the
  reverse as busy ends.
- **Focus:** keyboard only. Each cell has its own ring, round outside and square
  at the seam.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
The glow and the press show at once, and the release circle lands at once. The
chevron changes at once. The menu is the Menu's: there at once and gone at once.
Busy swaps at once.

V12/StatusIndicator.title: StatusIndicator
V12/StatusIndicator.summary:
A status as a mark and a label. Its props are Carbon's IconIndicator's (`kind`,
`label`, `size`), plus `labels`, `labelSwap` and `variant`.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Mark:** a new kind cuts to the new mark; to and from pending, the status
  hand-off (the spinner shrinks, the result's disc grows and its glyph draws).
- **Label:** out, then in, 8px on y; `labelSwap="in-place"` swaps it with no
  travel.
- **Width:** the label's width moves to the new one's with the in. Given
  `labels` (every label it can show), it keeps the widest one's width, so
  nothing shifts.
- **Pending:** the kit's spinner, held still while off screen.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text: The new mark and label are there at once, and the width changes with them.

V12/StepFlow.title: Step flow
V12/StepFlow.summary:
A create flow in steps: a progress indicator, one step's heading and fields at a
time, and Back and Next, with Submit on the last step. `StepFlow` draws it all
in place. `useStepFlow` returns the flow, so its parts can go anywhere:
`StepFlowProgress` for the indicator, `StepFlowBody` for the steps, and
`StepFlowActions` for the buttons, or `stepFlowActions(flow)` for a tearsheet's
`actions`. Back always moves. Next and Submit move only past valid steps; a
step's `invalid` holds Next on it, and its `disableSubmit` disables Next or
Submit. `onCancel` adds Cancel before Back. Each step is a region named by its
heading. Steps stay mounted while hidden, so Back keeps what was entered. Once
the old step has gone, focus moves to the new heading and the step is announced,
"Step 2 of 3: Access" by default.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Content movement in place:** a step change is the content swap along x, out
  then in, the way the flow goes. The old step leaves 8px, fading, on fast-01
  (exit-productive). Then the new one comes 8px from the end side on fast-02
  (entrance-productive). Back runs the other way, and right to left mirrors it.
- **Height:** the body's height holds through the out, then glides to the new
  step's height with the in, standard-productive.
- **The marker's glide and reach:** the progress indicator's own. Back and Next
  reach the marker toward their step as they are pressed.
- **An invalid step:** Next pressed on it moves nothing. The step shows its
  errors, its indicator step turns invalid, and focus goes to its first field in
  error.
- `timeScale` slows the swap and the buttons down.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
A step change is a snap: the new step is there on the frame the old one goes,
with no travel or fade, and the height changes at once. The indicator takes its
own reduced motion.

V12/StructuredList.title: StructuredList
V12/StructuredList.summary:
Rows of related details in columns, read across. `StructuredListWrapper` holds a
`StructuredListHead` and a `StructuredListBody` of `StructuredListRow`s and
`StructuredListCell`s, with the roles of a table. Columns size to their content,
with a hairline between rows. With `selection`, each row is a choice: a radio
mark in its leading cell, and a marker on the selected row. `isCondensed` gives
8px cells; `isFlush` removes the start padding, but not with `selection`.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Static:** without `selection`, the list has no hover and no motion.
- **Hover:** with `selection`, a body row takes the rollover: the quiet card
  hover, as an even wash. Rows press flat. The cells' text steps up to primary
  on the hover's clock. The selected row takes no hover and no release circle.
- **Selection glide:** the marker travels from the row it is on to the new one,
  timed by travel (40, 80, 120 or 160ms), its leading edge ahead. The first pick
  grows it in from its row's center. A row selected at first is placed at once.
- **Reach:** a press on another row reaches the marker toward it. Sliding to
  another row retargets; sliding off the list cancels. There is no drag.
- **Line frame:** with `frame="line"`, the default, the marker is the two row
  lines it lands on, 2px, with no fill and no sides. It is drawn the whole time
  it shows, so nothing switches on or off as it travels.
- **Ghost frame:** with `frame="ghost"`, the marker is a wash over the row.
  While it reaches or stretches across rows, the lines inside it hide and it
  carries a line on each edge.
- **Radio mark:** the dot grows from its center when chosen, over fast-02, and
  shrinks and fades when unchosen, over fast-01.
- **Keyboard:** each row's `StructuredListInput` is a hidden radio. They form
  one group with one tab stop; the arrow keys move and select. The row takes a
  2px ring for the keyboard only.
- **Slow motion:** `timeScale` slows the marker and the hover.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
The marker does not travel: it fades in at the new row while a ghost fades out
at the old, on half the clock. The hover changes at once. The radio's dot
changes at once.

V12/SystemMessage.title: SystemMessage
V12/SystemMessage.summary:
> **Problem statement:** A transcript needs to say what happened _to_ the
> conversation — the model changed, the context was cleared, a new day began —
> without that reading as something either party said. Carbon has no such
> object: `InlineNotification` is the nearest and is a different thing, with a
> container, a kind and a dismiss affordance that a transcript notice should not
> have. `SystemMessage` is the centred, recessive line between turns.

It is the companion to `HistoryRail`. The rail is the whole history at a glance,
down the edge of the panel; this is the same event in its place in the flow.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
> **Problem statement:** A transcript needs to say what happened _to_ the
> conversation — the model changed, the context was cleared, a new day began —
> without that reading as something either party said. Carbon has no such
> object: `InlineNotification` is the nearest and is a different thing, with a
> container, a kind and a dismiss affordance that a transcript notice should not
> have. `SystemMessage` is the centred, recessive line between turns.

It is the companion to `HistoryRail`. The rail is the whole history at a glance,
down the edge of the panel; this is the same event in its place in the flow.

sections.title: Severity
sections.text:
`severity` is the one axis that moves, and it moves three things together: the
ink, the glyph, and what a screen reader hears.

- **`status`** is a fact about the conversation. `$text-secondary`, no glyph,
  `role="status"` — it waits its turn.
- **`alert`** is something that cost the person work. `$text-primary`, a
  `WarningFilled` glyph, `role="alert"` — it interrupts.

Severity is never carried by colour alone: the glyph and the role move with it,
which is what keeps it legible in greyscale and to a reader (ACC-4).

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.text:
`variant="divider"` draws the text between two hairlines — a day boundary, a
session break. **It carries no severity**, and passing one does nothing: a
boundary is not something that went wrong.

V12/Tabs.title: Tabs
V12/Tabs.summary:
Move between views of one context. `Tabs` holds the state for a `TabList` and
its `TabPanels`, with Carbon's API: `selectedIndex`, `defaultSelectedIndex`,
`onChange` and disabled tabs. Line tabs, the default, ride a 2px underline on a
hairline; `frame="inset"` puts them in a track with a selector. A `Tab` takes an
icon before its label and a second line. `IconTab` is an icon only, named by its
tooltip, with an optional dot for something new. With `dismissable`, tabs close.
`TabsVertical` and `TabListVertical` are the vertical form.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Glide:** the selector, the underline or the inset selector, travels from
  where it is to the new tab, on standard-productive. Its duration comes from
  the distance, from fast-00 to moderate-01. Its leading edge stretches ahead. A
  new selection mid-glide starts from where the selector is.
- **Labels:** a label takes its selected face where the selector covers it:
  primary text, and heavier, held to its regular width. In line tabs it changes
  under the underline's span. On vertical tabs' `line` frame only the move's two
  ends change, and the bar slides past the tabs between.
- **Press:** a press on another tab reaches the selector toward it before the
  release. Slide to another tab to retarget; slide off to cancel. The pressed
  tab takes the pressed color while held.
- **Drag:** on by default. The selector follows the pointer and lands on the
  nearest enabled tab, with a 4px squash at the ends.
- **Landing:** a tab just picked keeps its hover round the selector until the
  selector has landed.
- **Hover:** unselected tabs take the rollover and a label step to primary. A
  motion icon plays on its tab's hover.
- **Tooltip:** an icon tab's name, and a label cut short, show in a tooltip on
  hover or keyboard focus. The pointer can move onto it.
- **Panels:** out, then in, along the list's axis, the way the selector moved.
  The old content moves 8px and fades, on fast-01 and exit-productive. The new
  content follows from 8px behind, on fast-02 and entrance-productive.
- **Panel box:** with `TabPanels fit="content"`, the default, the container
  resizes to the new panel as a window. `fit="largest"` holds the largest
  panel's size. With vertical tabs' `height`, the list and each panel scroll
  instead.
- **Close:** a dismissable tab closes with its × or Delete, which calls
  `onTabCloseRequest` with its index; remove the tab in response. The closed
  tab's copy fades as its space closes and the tabs after it slide in, on one
  clock and the glide's curve. The clock is the glide's for the farthest travel.
  A closed selected tab's selector glides on into the tab that takes the
  selection. Focus moves at once, to the tab that took its place, or the one
  before it if it was the last.
- **Overflow:** a list too long for its width scrolls, with no scrollbar. A
  scroll button fades in at each end that has more, on fast-02, and out on
  fast-01, with a 16px soft edge inside it. The selected or focused tab is kept
  clear of both. The buttons are out of the tab order.
- **Keyboard:** ← and → wrap and skip disabled tabs, ↑ and ↓ on vertical tabs;
  Home and End go to the ends. With `activation="automatic"` they select; with
  `manual` they move focus, and Enter or Space selects.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
No travel: the selector fades in on the new tab as it fades out of the old, on
half the clock. There is no reach. The pressed color still shows; the hover's
release is at once. The panels snap: the new one replaces the old on one frame,
and the container resizes at once. A closed tab is gone at once, with no copy.
The list scrolls to a tab, or by a page, without smooth scrolling. Tooltips show
and leave at once, with no drift.

V12/Tag.title: Tag
V12/Tag.summary:
A short label: a status, a kind, a count. `Tag` is Carbon's read-only tag. It is
content, not a control, and never answers the pointer. `SelectableTag` is a tag
the person turns on and off, on the rollover. `DismissibleTag` is a tag the
person can remove, with a close at its end. `TagSkeleton` is a tag while it
loads. They take Carbon's props, plus `corners`, `arrive`, `show` and
`timeScale` where they apply.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Snap from below, in:** a tag that appears in UI already on screen snaps in
  from below, 2px smaller, 3px at lg, up to full from its own center. It runs on
  moderate-01 with entrance-productive, and fades up over its first 40ms.
  `arrive="auto"` (the default) snaps it only when it arrives on its own, not
  with the page, card or list it came in; `true` always; `false` never.
- **Snap from below, out:** `show={false}` snaps it out, one step faster, on
  fast-02 with exit-productive, down to the same scale. It fades out over its
  last 40ms, then it is gone. Unmounted, it goes at once.
- **Stillness:** only the first tag of a run moves. The run is warm while a snap
  plays and for 400ms after the last one ends; a tag that appears then is simply
  there. Tags that appear on the same frame snap together.
- **Turn:** shown again mid-exit, or hidden mid-arrival, it turns round from
  where it is, on the share of the clock its travel leaves.
- **Rollover:** a SelectableTag's hover is a glow under the cursor, a flat press
  and a release from the point of release. Its fill changes on the rollover's
  clocks and it never moves. The DismissibleTag's close takes the rollover too,
  as a circle on its glyph.
- **Close icon:** hovering anywhere on a DismissibleTag plays its close icon.
  Enter, Space, Delete or Backspace on the close dismisses it. Focus moves to
  the next dismissible tag, or the previous one after the last. `onClose` asks
  the host to remove the tag.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
Tags arrive and leave at once, with no snap. A rollover's press still shows; its
release and re-hover are at once.

V12/TagSet.title: TagSet
V12/TagSet.summary:
A row of tags that fits its container. As many tags show as fit; the rest go
into a "+N" that opens them in a popover. With more than
`allTagsModalSearchThreshold` (10) in the overflow, the popover shows that many
and a "View all tags" button, which opens a modal of every tag with a search.
Each tag is a `label` and the kit Tag's props; one with `onClose` is a
DismissibleTag. `maxVisible` caps the row, and `multiline` wraps it instead.
`overflowType="tag"` lists the overflow as tags, `default` as text.
`TagSetSkeleton` is the set while it loads.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Reflow, out then in:** when the width moves tags into or out of the
  overflow, the tags leaving snap out where they are, as the Tag's out. Then the
  "+N" moves. Then the tags coming back snap in, staggered, as the Tag's in.
- **"+N" slide:** the "+N" slides from its old place to its new one, its clock
  from its travel over the tags between the two counts.
- **"+N" count:** the number rolls on the slide's clock. On a dismissal it
  waits, then rolls as the gap closes.
- **"+N" arriving or leaving:** when nothing overflowed before, it snaps in
  after the tags have left. When nothing overflows now, it snaps out first,
  before the tags come back.
- **Dismissal:** a tag taken out of `tags` snaps out where it was. Several leave
  20ms apart. Once the last has started, the gap closes in one move, its clock
  from its travel.
- **Arrival:** a tag added, or back from the overflow, snaps in once the gap has
  closed. The tags already there hold still.
- **Popover:** the kit's anchored Popover. It grows from the press point and
  leaves by folding back into it. It flips to stay on screen.
- **Modal:** the kit's Modal. Its search filters the tags out, then one reflow,
  then in, staggered.
- **Bursts:** changes less than 200ms apart land at once.

The set's tags never snap in on their own: the set plays their snap, once, on
its clock. The first fit is the set as it is, with no motion.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
No slide, roll or snap: the tags and the "+N" change at once. A dismissed tag is
gone at once, and a tag added is simply there. The popover is there at once and
gone at once. The modal takes its own reduced motion.

V12/Tearsheet.title: Tearsheet
V12/Tearsheet.summary:
A large sheet that rises from the bottom of the page for a task that needs room.
It has a header with a label, a title, a description and optional header
actions, a navigation row, an influencer column beside a scrolling main area,
and up to four footer actions. It follows `open`, and closes itself unless
`onClose` returns `false`. A sheet with no actions is passive: it has a close
button, and a press outside closes it. Escape closes the topmost sheet. Focus
moves in on open, Tab wraps inside, and focus goes back to `launcherButtonRef`,
else to what had it, as the sheet starts to leave. The page doesn't scroll while
a sheet is open. `TearsheetNarrow` is centred and has no influencer, navigation
or header actions. With `warm`, on by default, the sheet mounts hidden, with its
content, while its launcher is hovered or focused.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Snap rise:** the sheet enters by its bottom edge, from the middle of it. Its
  height starts at nothing and its width at 60%. Joined to the bottom, it takes
  the sliver guard: it is opaque from 4px tall, so no sliver shows.
- **Axial timing:** the height, the axis it enters along, takes the whole clock,
  and the width leads, done first. The clock comes from the sheet's size on the
  travel steps, one step shorter.
- **Collapse exit:** leaving, the top edge comes back down to the bottom at full
  width, two steps shorter than the entrance. The content holds still and the
  clip passes over it. The bottom stays square on every frame.
- **Content arrival:** the content rides up with the sheet along its height,
  from the first frame, over a short travel. It lands just after the sheet's
  longest axis clock.
- **Dim and blur:** the overlay and one even blur over the page come in on the
  sheet's clock, entrance-productive, and go out on its exit clock,
  exit-productive.
- **Page recede:** the page behind draws back on the sheet's clock,
  standard-productive, and comes back on the exit clock. `backdrop` leaves the
  scale or the blur out, or both with `false`.
- **Stack depth:** a sheet opened over another makes the one below recede to 98%
  per level about its top and lift 16px per level, so its top shows above the
  new one. It dims and rounds its bottom corners, on the arriving sheet's clock,
  standard-productive. It comes forward again on the leaving sheet's clock. A
  stack has one dim and one page recede, owned by its bottom open sheet.
- **Tooltip hold:** the tooltips inside wait until the sheet and its content
  have landed.
- `timeScale` slows the motion down.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
The sheet only fades, at its final geometry, on the reduced clock. Its content
doesn't move. The dim and the blur fade on the reduced clock, and the page
doesn't scale. In a stack, the sheet below recedes, lifts and rounds its corners
at once, and its dim fades on the reduced clock. Tooltips don't wait.

V12/TextArea.title: TextArea
V12/TextArea.summary:
Carbon's TextArea on the text input's field: the same label row and counter,
fill, outline, status mark and message line. It is `rows` lines tall, 4 by
default, and one row is the size's field height. It resizes vertically only;
with `cols`, disabled or read-only it does not resize. The status mark sits at
the top of the trailing edge, on the first line, and its room is kept, so a
status never re-wraps the text. `enableCounter` with `maxCount` shows
`count/maxCount` in the label row; `counterMode` counts characters or words.
Read-only and disabled beat both statuses, and invalid beats warn.
`TextAreaSkeleton` is the text area while it loads.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Outline ladder:** the text input's. The outline carries hover, press and
  focus. A press on a focused field holds its focus edge.
- **Error border:** an error's 2px border settles in once, on moderate-02. It
  never shakes.
- **Message line:** helper text, warning and error share one line and swap in
  place, out then in. The old text fades out on fast-01, then the new one fades
  in where it is. An error fades in on moderate-02, with the border. Nothing
  slides.
- **Status mark:** a change is the content swap, 8px down: the old mark leaves
  on fast-01, then the new one arrives on fast-02. From no status, it arrives at
  once. `statusBeat` plays the mark's icon once as it arrives.
- **Late status:** an error or warning that rises while typing waits for a pause
  (`typingPauseMs`, default 1000ms) or blur. It leaves on the keystroke that
  fixes it. `lateErrors={false}` shows every status at once.
- **Scroller:** text past the rows gets the kit's pill in place of the native
  bar, and a soft edge the text leaves into as it scrolls.
- **AI fill:** a filled value arrives by the content swap, 8px up, clipped to
  the field. A revert plays it back down.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
The message line, the status mark and an AI fill change at once. The outline and
the error border change on half of fast-01. A rising status still waits for the
pause or blur. The pill does not grow, glide or squash; it only fades.

V12/TextInput.title: TextInput
V12/TextInput.summary:
A single-line field: a label, the field with its outline and a status mark at
its trailing edge, and one message line for helper text, a warning or an error.
`TextInput` takes Carbon's props. `PasswordInput` adds a toggle that shows and
hides the password. `MultiFieldInput` is one field in segments, each with its
own value and validation. `TextInputSkeleton` is the field while its value
loads. `FieldMessage` and `FieldStatusMark` are the message line and the mark,
shared with other fields.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Outline ladder:** the outline carries every state. Hover moves it halfway
  from `$border-subtle` to `$border-strong`, in on fast-02. A press steps it to
  `$border-strong` at once, still 1px. Focus is the accent at 2px, on fast-01.
  Leaving any state takes fast-01. Disabled and loading fields have no ladder.
- **Placeholder:** while the field is empty, the placeholder rises toward
  `$text-secondary` with the ladder: a step on hover, more pressed and focused.
- **Error border:** an error settles in once, 1px to 2px of `$support-error`, on
  moderate-02 with entrance-productive. It never shakes. While focused, the
  focus edge wins.
- **Message line:** helper text, warning and error share one line and swap in
  place, out then in. The old text fades out on fast-01, then the new one fades
  in where it is: helper or warning on moderate-01, an error on moderate-02,
  with the border. Nothing slides.
- **Status mark:** a warning or error mark at the trailing edge. A change is the
  content swap, 8px on y: the old mark leaves on fast-01, then the new one
  arrives on fast-02. From no status, it arrives at once. `statusBeat` plays the
  mark's icon once as it arrives.
- **Late status:** an error or warning that rises while typing waits for a pause
  (`typingPauseMs`, default 1000ms) or blur. One that falls shows on the
  keystroke. `lateErrors={false}` shows every status at once.
- **Loading:** the value is a bar at the expected width; the label, frame and
  controls are drawn. When it loads, the bar dissolves in place as the value
  fades up.
- **AI fill:** a filled value arrives by the content swap, 8px, coming up from
  below, clipped to the field. A revert plays it back down.
- **Stillness:** nothing moves while typing.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
The message line, the status mark and an AI fill change at once. The outline and
the error border change on half of fast-01. A rising status still waits for the
pause or blur.

V12/ThemeZone.title: Theme zone
V12/ThemeZone.summary:
An area of the page in a theme of its own, through Carbon's `Theme`: `light` or
`dark` (white or g100), `page` (no zone of its own) or `inverse` (the opposite
of the theme round it).

V12/Tile.title: Tile
V12/Tile.summary:
A surface for content, with 8px corners and 16px in, on `--cds-surface`. `Tile`
is plain and has no hover. `ClickableTile` is a link with `href`, else a button.
`SelectableTile` holds a checkbox as its tab stop. `TileGroup` and `RadioTile`
choose one of a set. `ExpandableTile` shows `TileAboveTheFoldContent` and opens
to show `TileBelowTheFoldContent`. `TileSkeleton` is a tile while it loads. They
take Carbon's props, plus `hoverSteps`, `timeScale`, `footer`, `toggleArea` and
`onExpandedChange`. `decorator`, `slug`, `light`, `hasRoundedCorners`,
`tileMaxHeight` and `tilePadding` are accepted and do nothing.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Hover, text tile:** the rollover is painted behind the content, never over
  it. It steps off the fill: quiet, half the house steps, by default, or
  standard with `hoverSteps`. It fades in on fast-02 and out on fast-01, and the
  surface grows 1px. A press shows the pressed color at once and insets the
  surface 1px.
- **Hover, tile with controls:** a tile holding a checkbox, a radio or another
  control hovers with a 1px `$border-strong-01` inset ring and keeps its fill.
  It has no press and no growth. Pressed, its hairline takes `$text-secondary`
  at once.
- **Controls inside:** the innermost control owns the hover and the press. Over
  one, the tile goes to rest on fast-01, and fades back in on fast-02 when the
  pointer is on the tile again. The tile's own checkbox, radio and toggle keep
  the tile's hover. A click on a control inside never toggles, chooses or
  follows the tile.
- **Corner icon:** the clickable tile's motion arrow plays on hover and keyboard
  focus. Motion icons in its content play with it.
- **Selection:** a steady 2px ring in the selection color, with no transition.
  The hover and press tint under it. The checkbox and the radio mark take their
  own motion.
- **Fold:** the shared disclosure. The fold opens on the step for its travel,
  entrance-productive, and shuts one step faster, exit-productive. It is
  clipped, never scaled, under a soft edge of `min(16px, h, H − h)`. It is one
  layout change on the tile's container, so what is below is pushed once, and
  tiles there that change together move as one motion. A toggle mid-move turns
  from where the fold is.
- **Fold content:** opening, it comes 8px down into place from the first frame
  and settles just after the fold lands. Shutting, it holds still. On a turn it
  resumes at once.
- **Expandable tile hover:** one quiet hover step, with no press or release over
  a surface that grows. The toggle has its own text rollover in its letters. Its
  chevron points down when shut and up when open.
- **Above the fold:** with `toggleArea="above-the-fold"`, the wash goes to rest
  on fast-01 over the opened part, and comes back over the top part and the
  toggle's row.
- **First paint:** no motion.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
The hover and the ring change at once. The press still shows; the release and
the return to hover are at once. The icons hold still and change state at once.
The checkbox and radio marks appear at once. The fold opens or shuts at once,
with no soft edge, and its content fades in on the reduced clock.

V12/TimePicker.title: TimePicker
V12/TimePicker.summary:
Carbon's TimePicker on the kit's text field: a short field for the time
(`hh:mm`) and its selects beside it, under one label, over one message line.
`TimePicker` takes Carbon's props, including `warning` and `warningText`. Its
children are `TimePickerSelect`s, native `<select>`s for AM / PM or a time zone.
They take the picker's size, its `disabled` unless they set their own, and its
`readOnly`, which holds their value.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Outline ladder:** the text input's, on the field and on each select. Hover
  moves the hairline halfway to `$border-strong` on fast-02, a press steps it to
  `$border-strong` at once, and focus is the accent at 2px. Leaving takes
  fast-01.
- **Error border:** the text input's: an error settles in once.
- **Message line:** warning and error share one line and swap in place, out then
  in.
- **Status mark:** the text input's. A change is the content swap: the old mark
  leaves, then the new one arrives. A status shows at once, with no wait for a
  pause in typing.
- **Field width:** the field widens for the status mark at once as a status
  shows. When it goes, the field keeps its width for fast-01, then narrows.
- **Icon hover:** each select is its chevron's icon frame, so the chevron's
  motion plays on the select's hover.

The selects' lists are the platform's own, with no motion of ours.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
The outline and the error border change on half of fast-01. The message line and
the status mark change at once.

V12/Toggle.title: Toggle
V12/Toggle.summary:
A switch for a setting. It is a track with two stops, and its knob is the
selection family's selector. `Toggle` takes Carbon's props: `labelText`,
`labelA` and `labelB` for the state text, `size`, `toggled`, `defaultToggled`,
`onToggle`, `disabled` and `readOnly`. It adds `corners`, `variant`, `mark`,
`disabledReason`, `motion`, `timeScale` and `onMove`. It is a `role="switch"`
button, and Space and Enter flip it. `ToggleSkeleton` is the toggle while it
loads.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Glide:** a click, a key or a change of `toggled` moves the knob as the
  family's selector moves. Its leading edge runs ahead, at most half the travel.
  The duration comes from the distance.
- **Color:** the on color is a fill that rides the knob's live place. The knob's
  color follows its place too, so the two ease together over the glide, or with
  the pointer in a drag.
- **Mark:** the status dot sits at the stop the knob isn't on. It fades on
  fast-02. A hero or status track never shows it.
- **Press:** anywhere on the track, the knob included, the knob reaches 2px
  toward the other side at once. At `md` the track also shrinks 1px a side; at
  `sm` it doesn't. A grabbed knob insets 1px.
- **Drag:** the knob follows the pointer and stops at the walls with the kit's
  squash. It lands on the nearer side.
- **State text:** both texts share one cell, so the row keeps its width and
  nothing beside it moves.
- **Tonal track:** with `variant="tonal"`, the track takes its hue from where it
  sits.
- **Hover:** none. The reach on a press and the inset on a grab are the
  feedback.
- **Focus:** keyboard only, 2px `$text-primary`, outside the track with a 2px
  gap. It has no transition.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
The knob doesn't glide. It fades in on the side it lands on and out on the
other, at half the duration. The color changes at once.

V12/Toggletip.title: Toggletip
V12/Toggletip.summary:
A button that opens a small high-contrast panel on click, for help that holds a
link or an action, where a tooltip can't. The parts take Carbon's props:
`Toggletip`, `ToggletipLabel`, `ToggletipButton`, `ToggletipContent` and
`ToggletipActions`. It is built on the kit's Popover and takes its props. A
click on the button toggles it. Escape closes it and returns focus to the
button; a press outside, focus leaving or the window losing focus closes it. The
panel is rendered in place, so Tab goes from the button into it.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Open:** the Popover's floating snap. The frame grows from the press on the
  button, or from its center by keyboard, and the content rides it on y. Opened
  from the start, with no gesture, it is there with no motion.
- **Close:** the far edge folds back toward the button. The panel is gone on the
  fold's last frame.
- **Fade:** it fades up over the first part of the open and out over the last
  part of the close: 40ms on a clock of 220ms or less, else 80ms.
  `exitFade={false}` folds back opaque.
- **Interrupted:** pressed again while it leaves, it turns round from where it
  is.
- **Soft edge:** on every side where the frame clips the content,
  `min(16px, h, H − h)` per side.
- **Button:** the rollover in a 26px full-round fill: a neutral glow, grown 1px
  on hover, a press back to rest, then the release. While open, the selected
  fill.
- **Icon:** the Information motion icon plays on hover.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
The panel is there at once and gone at once: no growth, slide, fade or soft
edge. The button's press still shows; its release and re-hover take the 1ms
floor.

V12/Toolbar.title: Toolbar
V12/Toolbar.summary:
A row or a column of controls with one tab stop. `ToolbarButton` is an action
and `ToolbarToggle` a toggle: a ghost icon button whose label is its tooltip and
its name, or a labelled button. `ToolbarToggleGroup` holds toggles that belong
together: `single` is a selection track with one choice, `multiple` keeps each
toggle's own pressed fill. `ToolbarGroup` keeps controls together, and
`ToolbarDivider` draws a hairline between them. In a row, what does not fit
moves into a More menu. The arrow keys move between controls, with Home and End;
they do not wrap unless `wrap` is set. In a single group, the arrows move focus
without choosing, and Enter or Space choose.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Rollover:** every control takes the rollover's matched-lightness hover and
  press. There is no hover growth, and a press insets 1px. A motion icon plays
  on its control's hover.
- **Selection glide:** a single group's selector glides to the new choice on a
  clock set by its travel, as the content switcher's does. It reaches toward a
  press before the release, and it can be dragged.
- **Pressed fill:** a toggle's pressed fill is the variant's selector fill. It
  fades in on fast-02 and out on fast-01, on standard-productive.
- **Tooltip:** icon controls share one tooltip. It shows 100ms after the pointer
  arrives. Moving to a neighbor puts it there at once, its text changing in
  place. It leaves fast-02 after the pointer goes.
- **Snap mark:** when controls first move into the menu, the More button arrives
  as the snap's mark: from half size about its center, on fast-02,
  entrance-productive. It leaves at once. A toolbar that is already narrow when
  it mounts simply has one.
- **Overflow:** trailing controls leave the row and come back with no motion. A
  group moves as one, and no divider is left before the More button. Inside a
  layout transaction, the cut is made once, when the layout settles. In the
  menu, buttons are items, toggles are checkable items, a single group is radio
  items and a multiple group is a group of checkable items.
- **Tonal:** a tonal toolbar takes its hue from where it sits.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
The selector does not glide, and there is no reach. The More button is there at
once. Tooltips show and leave at once. The pressed fill still fades.

V12/Tooltip.title: Tooltip
V12/Tooltip.summary:
Short labels and descriptions on hover and keyboard focus. `Tooltip`,
`IconButton`, `DefinitionTooltip` and `TooltipGroup` take Carbon's props and
share one look: the inverse fill, 4px corners and no caret. Escape dismisses a
tooltip, and the pointer can move onto it without it leaving. Only one tooltip
shows on the page at a time.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **In:** the first tooltip of a run waits its enter delay (100ms), then grows
  from the pointer, where it is when the tooltip snaps: width from 25%, height
  from 75%, on fast-01 and entrance-snap. The text slides on y and never scales.
- **From the keyboard:** it grows from the trigger's center, clamped into the
  box, and does not drift.
- **Fade:** it fades up as it grows and out as it folds, on the fade standard.
  `exitFade={false}` folds back opaque.
- **Warm:** while any tooltip shows, or within 400ms of the last one leaving,
  the next one is there at once at its final geometry: no delay, no snap, no
  fade. It leaves the same way, after its leave delay.
- **Moving on:** in a `TooltipGroup`, the one tooltip jumps to the next trigger,
  its text changing in place.
- **Drift:** while hovered, it follows the pointer along the trigger's edge, on
  one axis, at most 2px and 10% of its own size, on fast-02 and
  entrance-productive.
- **Out:** after its leave delay, the last tooltip of a run folds its far edge
  back into the trigger and is gone on its last frame.
- **Leave delay:** 120ms (fast-02) for a label, as on `IconButton` and
  `TooltipGroup`; 300ms (moderate-03) for text worth reading, as on `Tooltip`
  and `DefinitionTooltip`, so the pointer can cross onto it.
- **Interrupted:** back on the trigger while it leaves, it turns round from
  where it is.
- **Stillness:** a trigger that arrives under a resting pointer opens its
  tooltip only once the pointer moves more than 0.5px.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
Every tooltip, the first one too, is there at once after its enter delay and
gone at once after its leave delay. There is no drift.

V12/TreeView.title: TreeView
V12/TreeView.summary:
A hierarchy of nodes to open, shut and select. `TreeView` holds `TreeNode`s; a
node with child nodes is a parent, and its caret opens and shuts it. One node is
selected, under the selection kit's selector. With `multiselect`, every row has
a checkbox and there is no selector. `variant` sets the selector's style and
`size` the row height. `TreeViewSkeleton` is the tree while it loads.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **Glide:** between two leaves of one group, the selector glides. All four
  edges share one clock from the longest travel, the leading edge ahead. Labels
  take the selected face where it covers them.
- **Jump:** every other move jumps: to another parent or depth, and to or from a
  parent's row. The old selector shrinks 4px and is gone, then the new one grows
  in from 4px small, on fast-01, a third out and two thirds in. The pointer, the
  keyboard and a change to `selected` or `active` take the same rule.
- **Landing hover:** the new row keeps its hover around the selector until the
  selector lands. On a jump, that hover shrinks with the old selector.
- **Press:** the selector reaches toward the pressed row. Slide to another row
  to retarget, or off to cancel. There is no drag.
- **Arrival and fold:** shutting a parent over the selected node takes the
  selector with the row, at once. Opening it again, the selector arrives on the
  row once the children have landed.
- **Disclosure:** a parent's children open and shut on the disclosure module, on
  the travel's step; shutting is one step faster. The children come down 8px
  with the opening, and the soft edge closes over them on the way out. Every
  node that changes in one commit is one motion on the tree.
- **Caret:** the caret turns on the same clock and curve as the children's
  opening.
- **Rollover:** every row takes the kit's rollover. The caret and icon step up
  on hover, in on fast-02 and out on fast-01. A motion icon plays on its row's
  hover.
- **Checkboxes:** with `multiselect`, a parent's box follows its enabled
  children: all checked, checked; some, mixed; none, unchecked. Toggling a
  parent sets every enabled node under it. Disabled nodes aren't counted.
- **Keyboard:** ↑ and ↓ move between visible nodes, with Home and End. → opens a
  parent or goes to its first child; ← shuts it or goes to the parent. Enter and
  Space select, and Enter also toggles a parent. Type-ahead finds a node. With
  `multiselect`, Space toggles a node, Enter selects it alone, Ctrl + A selects
  every visible node, and Ctrl + Shift + Home or End selects to the end. The
  tree is one tab stop.
- **Double-click:** on a parent's row, it opens or shuts the parent. Not on the
  caret or the checkbox.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
No travel. A parent opens or shuts at once, its children fading in. A glide
becomes a fade: the selector fades in at the new node while a ghost fades at the
old. A jump puts it on the new row at once. The caret turns at once.

V12/UserAvatar.title: UserAvatar
V12/UserAvatar.summary:
A person as their initials, their picture or an icon in a coloured circle, with
the props of Carbon for IBM Products' `UserAvatar`. The initials are the first
and last name's first letters, or a single name's first two; with no name it
shows the User icon, or `renderIcon`. Sizes are sm 24, md 32 (the default), lg
40 and xl 48px. The twelve colours follow the Carbon theme it sits in; `theme`
names one outright. `UserAvatarSkeleton` is its loading state.

sections.title: Motion
sections.text:
- **At rest:** nothing moves on its own: no hover, no press. It isn't a control.
- **Image:** the initials or the icon show until the image loads, then swap to
  it, out then in, never overlapping. The initials leave up 8px, fading, over
  `fast-01`; then the image comes up from 8px below over `fast-02`, clipped by
  the circle. `timeScale` slows the swap.
- **Already loaded:** an image loaded when the avatar first paints is simply
  there, with no swap.
- **New image:** the initials come back until it loads, then it swaps in. A
  broken image keeps the initials.
- **Tooltip:** with `tooltipText` the avatar is a button and the kit's Tooltip
  names it. It snaps in from the pointer. Along a run of avatars only the first
  tooltip snaps; the next ones appear in place.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.text:
The swap is a snap: the image is there on the frame the initials go. The tooltip
is there at once.
